title: Daily gateway traffic
description: Requests, tokens by kind, errors and estimated cost (USD) per day, for every provider or the one picked. Reads daily_usage.

args.sql:
SELECT day, SUM(requests) AS requests,
  SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens, SUM(cache_tokens) AS cache_tokens, SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  SUM(errors) AS errors, ROUND(SUM(cost_usd), 2) AS cost_usd
FROM daily_usage
WHERE (CAST({{provider}} AS TEXT) IS NULL OR provider = CAST({{provider}} AS TEXT))
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day
